author: Mark Atwood
text: Workspace-canonical reclassification filed as JMAP-x2gd.87. The hand-maintained `*_READONLY: &[&str]` pattern with its `MAINTENANCE:` comment is present on the canonical extension-server template (jmap-mail-server: mailbox.rs:661-663, identity.rs:323) with byte-equivalent comment text. Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' propagation rule, the fix must land on the canonical (jmap-mail-types + jmap-mail-server) first then propagate to all 8 extension-server crates and their types crates in the same pass. Leaving .14 open as the chat-server manifestation; will close when JMAP-x2gd.87's sweep lands and propagates here. Note: the mitigation choice itself (trait method vs proc-macro vs serde-attribute) is workspace-architectural and may need its own decision bead before the sweep can be worked.
